notes.title: Sound and Movement
notes.notes: [p]Howdy all you[/p][p]We’re writing from Prague… with an epic monthly update (it’s epic) This month the world of GoF inched quite close to feeling alive thanks to a few incredibly important strides we’ve made in development. Namely… [/p][p]- Sound design - foley, sounds of nature, npc noises, as well as…[/p][p]- Character dialogue (in experimentation again) - we’re ironing out the speech samples and trying different approaches. Sadly felekese dialogue had to be put on hold due to full voice acting with a made-up language being a bit difficult to uniformly pull off by a team of people, but it doesn’t mean we’re giving up on giving the characters a voice! [/p][p]- A new addition to our team, meaning skillfully made new animations, sprites and visuals - We’ve welcomed a new artist to our entourage :) And she’s really cool and we’re working on finding the middle ground in our combined artstyles (it’s going very well) [/p][p][/p][p] Overall, a playable demo is baking. notes.title: We're still working hard - new playable demo in development
notes.notes:
You might be curious - what exactly is going on with the video game i wait so much for and think about every day?? Did the people responsible for it run away to a tropical island yet?? The answer is: no! We have been considering going to a tropical island for sure, but we decided that it can wait for after Ghost of Fall is released and we can bask in it’s glory. „But how is that going????” - we can hear you asking impatiently as you shed a tear of impatientness. Here is the answer full and unabridged: 

There currently exists, on a piece of A4 paper, a list of things that we need to work on before we can show our game to a wider, although not too wide, public. The list consists of 32 bullet points, out of which some are marked with a star - the star representing a stellar and more menacing undertaking, as compared to a point unstarred. Out of those points - roughly ten have been decisively crossed out with a black pen rendering them done and closed forever. Many others could be already crossed partially, as they have been partially finished, but a partial cross would be devoid of meaning and look like a mere mishap. Good thing is - the list was created just couple days ago, so, as it seems, we might be done with it rather soon.

And when we will - we’ll show you what we’ve done. Regardless of whether it’s the 17’th or not. 

Also, here's concept art of Kassi - a character that appears early in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945298/6a65ff9cf4be3f0a677b4f50e9e34a8a915b08a7.png[/img]

Have a great afternoon.

Karibu

notes.title: Year Summary/Season Greetings
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
17'th of December, 2024, - this is time for both the monthly update, as well as the last update post of the year, so we'll try to sum up what we've done this year!

Most importantly we aaaalmost finished the demo we talked about in September. 
There's still a few things that could use a bit more polish, and with the Christmas break comes some much needed free time to make that happen.
Luckily in small indie dev, deadlines are guidelines, so we can have a little extra studio time as a treat 🙂 

We hope that despite the holdup you'll hang around for it - or even more, we're really counting on it! 
We'd love our small community to be the first people to enjoy, and praise or roast our work 🙂 We'll keep you updated on how that's going. For now, a few maps and animations need polish as well as general audio design. (We were so focused on everything else that we completely forgot it exists in some areas 💀 )

If you're interested - be sure to join our discord for more info, but even if you don't - we will let you know here!

We're super excited. And we hope you are, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945298/e97e73ccdbbd62a6eec4b621aa36c9ad3a26c5c0.jpg[/img]

Honestly, this year was a bummer of a time, sure a lot of people can relate. It wasn't easy, but we kept soldiering on, and today we have what is almost a finished, polished demo 🙂 
Exactly a year ago we showed you our first truly finished background drawing as a milestone - today? The game is full of them, with even more detail and flare, for now as far and wide as the demo goes 🔥 

...oh, and this year, we managed to do 11 montly update posts, and as most of you know, there are 12 months in a year- that's possible personal best beating territory for 2025 💪 🦌 Karibu strong

Ghost of Fall as a whole is shaping up to be one heck of a massive project, but with our ever-growing experience, we're only getting better at making it, so we think we'll still be going strong this time next year, too!

If so, we hope we'll see you all in here for the next Christmas - maybe even there'll be more of us!

Merry Tuesday! (Not Christmas yet sadly)
Karibu Digital Entertainment
Felocai
Ravioli
Absent

notes.title: Sunset Over Taro
notes.notes:
Tiny... yet important update this month - another huge location in the game is practically completed (while we're wrestling the engine for cool effects)
The early section of the game is not only playable - it looks really nice too :)
Here's a snippet of how it looks ingame.

[previewyoutube=uafllwffkOs;full][/previewyoutube]

...But a finalized art direction isn't the most important part of this month.
You see, two years ago we have published the Ghost of Fall demo that many of you might know the game from. 
We've learned a lot from feedback and practice as rookie devs, so between the demo and today we've took many months learning new skills, practicing, researching, prototyping, conceptualizing, demoing and sketching the full game that would eventually come from that idea. 
The three of us are now at a stage of confidence in our skills, and GoF as a project. Therefore...

It's finally time to construct a pitch and talk to game publishers - with a team of just three of us, it's nearly impossible to pull off marketing and all that mumbo jumbo ourselves, especially with us three working full-time (outside of developing GoF). 
Can't say how that'll affect the monthly updates, but you can probably expect them to slow down for the next ~2 months, since we'll be busy putting together materials needed for making the right pitch. 
Of course, 17'ths will still be update days, but they will probably be smaller for a while. 

If our work finds finding, however, you can expect progress to degrees we've never been able to pull off yet - so please wish us the best 💪 🦌 

That's all for tonight... but we're hoping to bring good news by december

notes.title: Puzzles and Locks
notes.notes:
Good evening, it's that time of the month 'o clock... Busier and sweatier than ever (due to the heat mostly, but also we are really working a lot 💪 ) 
This August brings a little puzzle/minigame showcase, some vfx, some audio design...

[previewyoutube=EdrSGdGyPFo;full][/previewyoutube]

Quite simple puzzle, but it's the first one in the game, can't be too hard 🙂 
Luckily for Ward, the world in GoF is peppered with locked doors, strange machines and different navigational challenges that need figuring out.

Obviously coming up with good puzzles is no easy task and as history proved again and again - bad puzzles can wreck a game.
 We are planning to overcome this by:

Subjecting all our design choices to blind playtests and taking feedback into consideration.
Not focusing on making the puzzles hard, instead making them satisfying and interesting to complete, we're not trying to be Myst 🙂

This is still kind of treading new ground for us, but still, it rocks. Coming up with ideas, putting them to use and then having fun with what we've made is very deeply rewarding 😄 
It takes time to focus on details like VFX and sounds, but we think it's 100% worth it.

Thanks for sticking around for another month. We are one month closer to finishing this game and we hope you're all allright as well.

Have a great evening 🦌 
Karibu

notes.title: Under The Falling Leaves
notes.notes:
Hello everyone

17'th! Woohoo! An that means we have an update post!

As you all know, the game in the making is called Ghost of Fall - but besides sounding cool, this title contains a double meaning 🙂 
One of those meanings is literal - the game takes place in autumn (also called fall) and we want to use the beauty of the season to our advantage. 
Here's a video of Ward strolling through one of the already "autumnized" locations. Tune in and enjoy the ghost of fall 😄 

[previewyoutube=yj9YpDi3z1o;full][/previewyoutube]

As far as general news goes, we are still sort of scrambling to work as much as possible on the game. The summer is not being very kind to all of us with its heatwaves, but we push ourselves very hard (sometimes too hard) to make steady progress. Hopefully the FALL will be kinder to us (get it?), but despite of all that - we are moving forWARD (get it?) and looking back at our progress, we're glad it's going in a nice direction. (get i- oh wait, no pun here.)

Do let us know what you think about this visual showcase - we know what we think, but the more opinions, the more to consider 🙂 

kindest regards
karibu 🦌

PS. we have said goodbye to the outdated idle animation of our main character - Ward. The old animation was one of the very first assets made for the game, so it's worth pointing that out.

notes.title: JUNE UPDATE: WARD
notes.notes:
It's the 17th - time for a monthly update, and while this one seemingly doesn't have much going on, it's a very important day for our team as a huge chunk of the team can take a long break from academia and return to working on the game :)
Due to personal reasons this month's been rather slow for hands-on work in our team, but things are looking great looking forward! 

I hope you enjoy the painting we've made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945298/b236f330b75ebeb9c46df7bcfa5c5116197a7e39.jpg[/img]

While that's all we have for you this update, the three of us will be working hard to push the chapter to completion soon :)
We're always happy to show you stuff, but the closer we get to finishing the chapter, the harder it gets to make the updates engaging without spoiling too much...

------------

Not long after Ward and his twin sister Liisa moved to Taro, the two had a rather serious falling out... 
Serious enough, that it took almost seven years of no contact between them for Ward to consider a family reunion. 
After long days of coming up with excuses, he couldn't reach a conclusion different than having to finally face Liisa and her son - Alek - once again. 

While they used to be very close, the two couldn't have ended up more different.
After all, Liisa settled down and started a family, while Ward kept trying to relive his adventorous glory days, for better or worse... Who knows what kind of felek she must have become after all those years? 
Once again, even in this case, Ward's curiosity had the winning hand.

...unbeknowst to him, or anyone else, he picked a really bad time to try and bridge the gap between him and his family. 
Somewhere, from the depths of the underground, a mysterious force calls out for Ward - offering a mission, an adventure he's been waiting for his entire life.
For now, however... he's enjoying a nice view, and a breath of fresh air. 

see you soon :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945298/34fa3abfecc56151d8e4d886d00314b9e6edab3b.png[/img]

notes.title: Fighting Feleks
notes.notes:
Hiiii 

So, we've posted lore, music, writing, atmosphere, visuals and stuff before - of course that's important stuff but this time it's time for gameplay mechanics instead 👾 
We've got a playable build/testing ground for different game modes - this build's got 4, but way more to go :)

Technically, the current design is superior and will allow us to make the battles more interesting, fitted to music, adaptable, satisfying... well, in theory, all that jazz :)

...Don't just take my word for it, but the team agrees that what we have already has a much better feel and way more potential than the battles in the previous game demo 🥲 hooray for modular design!

[previewyoutube=EU7DS0KzjEk;full][/previewyoutube]

------------------------------

And now for those who've watched, a quick FAQ:
(we asked Maatii the future teller to tell us what people might ask 🦌 🫸🪩🫷 )

DO ALL FIGHTS LOOK LIKE THIS?
Nope, this one's unique! Ward is just playing an old video game. Not to say other fights won't be unique, but they'll be visually way more "realer" and fitted to the respective ingame sceneries.

ARE THERE ONLY 4 GAME MODES?
No - more's to come, that's just the modes working in this current build!

HOW MANY FIGHTS WILL THERE BE IN THE GAME?
At least 10, but maybe more for the type of felek keen to explore...

------------------------------
This is all we have for you now! We're open to questions if Maatii missed any :)
Have a good evening!

notes.title: Talks and Squabbles
notes.notes:
Another month, another update

Last month we've posted an update leaning on the artistic side of things and there's been people asking about seeing some more active gameplay in the next update.
This month we wanted to show off the revamped combat, but fate decided that it's this month that our coding powerhouse were to be the busiest he's been in a long time :)
So instead, for this month, we've got a different mechanic in the making:

[previewyoutube=Gj2MsxN2cls;full][/previewyoutube]

While the game's main story is linear, we're incorporating tons of choice-based dialogue for flavour and... well, other, hopefully fun reasons :)
Coupled with everything else, surprisingly hard feature to pull off in that game's engine, but thanks to Mr Powerhouse himself, we're getting there!

...and since adding audio is not very coding-heavy, and as we don't like to sit idly, we're sticking with dubbing the whole game in the Felek language. 
(With way too much time in the hands of the art "department", a lot of planning went into constructing its linguistics and all :) )
Do let us know what you think :)

PS.
More action-oriented bits of the game coming soon. 
Hopefully starting next month 🙂

Have a great evening!
~Karibu🦌

Rezz' Aja [rezz aya] is a kind of a typically sweet, brightly purple wine created with the use of the rezz fruit, growing in the area known by the Felek as Kerrotesa Manai. Besides sourcing the fruit, most of the wine is also produced locally over there.

It is also... the title of the soundtrack heard in this video:

https://youtu.be/pe0R2pT3LOw

Consider it a teaser of "Ghost of Fall" - showcasing one of the finished tracks as well as enviromental animations in one of our much loved locations.

Technicalities aside and all... That's the feel of the game, right there! 🙂

In our humble (perhaps a bit biased) opinion, we think it looks and sounds pretty great - hope you feel that way too 🙂

notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 🦌 

Christmas approaches, and with it - the end of the year (and beginning of the new💫 )

With another year going by, our work on Ghost of Fall continues. Some of the in-game locations are already beginning to reach their final form :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945298/89bd3ab012f3fdcc3a11d829e4a411106b4669d2.png[/img]

As we don't want to spoil the game, from now on we'll probably show less of the ingame locations before the chapter's finished. We hope that's understandable, and we'll still post things to look at, here and there :)

Our programming department (which is just one guy by the way - bless his overworked soul) is working very hard to implement all the animations and art made by our artists into the actual computer program that is Ghost of Fall and slowly, bit by bit, the game becomes more and more the adventure that we want it to be.

In a poetic fashion we are ending this year just as we started it - by working on a game we love working on. We overcame a lot of obstacles, came up with a lot of great new ideas and drew millions of pixels and we will continue doing just that in the upcoming year of 2024!

notes.title: Deletion of The Demonstrative version of "Ghost of Fall"
notes.notes:
A bit of a different announcement post today 🦌 .
As some of you have noticed, the demo is no longer available on Steam - the reason for that is that we don't think the demo version of the game is representative of how the full game is coming out to be.

What's important - We have taken the (many) complaints you had about it very seriously, and we're implementing all changes necessary into the game.

So, what would those changes be exactly?

- The pixel size is now unified between backgrounds and sprites. The artistic decision to keep the sizes different has proven to be jarring and unpleasant to look at. It just looks much better the way it is now.

- We rethinked our approach to designing fights. The fight with Rass in the demo has proven to be too difficult and unfair for the players. We have many ideas for the upcoming fight segments in the full version of Ghost of Fall, like more movement options for Ward, easier to predict attacks, more variation between attempts and more!

- Since the demo's release, we've spent a lot of time designing the world. While most of what you see and hear in the demo still makes sense within those new perspectives, some things actively go against of what we want to happen in the full game. This would also need to change if we were to keep the demo online. A little bit of retcon in there. Just a spoonful, but how meaningful...

- We added the "Closer Look" mechanic, the journal and inventory system, new interface elements, new animations etc. Those things don't exist in the demo and we find they're integral to the feel of the game now, so it doesn't make much sense that the demontrative version wouldn't demontstrate those things.

- We've slightly expanded our art department. While there was a small overhaul to the demo a few months ago, it still doesn't accurately show the attention to detail that we're capable of right now and may give a bad impression to any newcoming players.
 
While technically possible, putting all of those changes into the demo would mean making it from scratch, which brings us to the second main reason of deletion.

The demo actually became quite difficult to work with over time. When we started working on the app itself in 2021 it served as a test ground for the many ideas we had and solutions we had to test. The demo taught as a lot, but it at the same time working on it has become so difficult that it doesn't really make sense to keep it around.
Now, does that mean that the demo is gone forever?

We like to call the now gone demo "Chapter 0" of Ghost of Fall, as it's something meant to happen right before the main story. 
Because of this, we would love for this short episode of the game to return in the future in some way! 
Our hopes for now is to completely re-do this part of the game so that it fits the finished product more and make it an optional part of the full story. This is, however, a task we have to postpone - making such a huge game with such a small team is no easy task, and we still have a lot of work on. 

So to answer the question - it's gone in it's current form, but it's not gone for good 🙂

(That said, if you still want to play the old version of the demo, we are not planning to delete it from our itch.io and gamejolt pages.)

It's a bit of a long post, but we felt that this deserves a proper explaination. In the next update we will let you know about more cool stuff we're making right now, but this is our update post for now.

Have an electrifying evening! ⚡️

notes.title: A closer look at Taro
notes.notes:
Hello!

In case you were wondering... developement on Ghost of Fall is going okay! :) 
This year, our summer holidays go into working on the game, which definitely makes our progress faster.

So, what are we doing right now? Mostly adding fine details to the locations we already have drawn. It is during this stage that we add the "Closer Look" areas of the game. It's really fun to make them, and they're a really nice atmosphere-building addition :)
One of those "closer looks" you can see here: Taro as seen from a mountain trail at sunset. One of the first "closer looks" of the game (there's already a lot, and there well be many many more)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945298/8be40da1ba59dfbf3e40cac417ff9c68321000cc.png[/img]

Taro is the city where the story of Ghost of Fall (mostly) takes place. Built a long time ago in the Stone Crown Valley, and left abandoned for over three hundred years for... unclear reasons. 
Well. Of course now it's inhabited by over ten thousand feleks and among them, there's Ward! A felek drawn to the old city and its mysteries.

A lot of our hearts go into making Taro an interesting place, we're going back work right away. And when we're done - hope to see you there!

Have a good day!

notes.title: CLOSER LOOK/A MONTH LONG BREAK
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945298/dbecd994c8611aeeccfcede80bf05cced882ddb2.png[/img]

Hello everyone, we are here with a little two-part update on our work

[b]CLOSER LOOK[/b]
As usual we want to share a feature we are working on right now. The world of Ghost of Fall is highly detailed and to show you more of those details, we came up with an idea of CLOSER LOOK.
Closer look is a name for segments of the game in which you can quite literally take a closer look at certain areas, objects and places.
Each one of those segments, other than allowing you to see more details, will feature its own interactions and animations. Sometimes taking a closer look will be necessary to progress and sometimes it will just provide an extra layer of detail to the world.

[b]A MONTH-LONG BREAK[/b]
Other than sharing progress we feel it is important to let you know that we will sadly have to take a one month long break in our work, because one of our developers is facing pretty tough personal situations and we believe that only as a full team our work is as good as it can be. Up until this point we have been working non-stop and we are confident we will be able to resume our work as soon as the end of June. We want to be as transparent as possible with the state of our game, so it feels fair to let you know. 

This is our update for now. We already can't wait to get back to work. We also can't wait to share more of the things that are about to come, but you will surely see that in the future. Have a great evening and see you soon!

notes.title: Dialogue Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42945298/dc50b19d81288f6661f8a71681824246dd595670.png[/img]

We're here, as always - with a tiny update on what's going on!
It's hard to single out one thing that we're working on (since we try to work on everything at once), but one of those many things is the look, feel, and the inner workings of our dialogue boxes.
We're putting a lot of care into the boxes - not only so they'd look prettier, but also to make the characters feel more alive.
We've decided to add larger, more expressive character sprites and custom, handmade fonts for main cast - while talking, you'll get to see portraits of the characters that change depending on their emotions, feelings, thoughts, reactions and so on.
That feature required a rework of the game's backend to accommodate the new additions, too!
For now we're testing this concept just with Ward, but as it feels like a great idea, work to add portraits to all talkable NPCs is already underway.
Feel free to compare it to the screenshot of one of the game's earliest builds!

That's the occasional update for now!
As usual we can't wait to show you more progress, so stay tuned, have a great day, and hope to see you soon!

notes.title: GHOST OF FALL NUMBERS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
We are hard at work with Ghost Of Fall and are happy to announce some things you will be able to enjoy while playing:

• 43 Unique hand drawn locations with their own atmosphere, music and (non playable) characters

• 100+ Music tracks (estimated over 5 hours of unique music)

• 50+ NPCs with their own personality, dialogue and voices

• 10 Obligatory fights with more optional ones scattered through the world
 
• Estimated 5 hours of gameplay 

And of course a highly detailed and moving story told with all of the above!

We are confident that we'll be able to finish our work somewhere in 2024, although we reserve our right to release the game when it's ready, since nobody likes an unfinished game.

Have a great evening and see you soon!
